# AH Design AI rules

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [design-system.json](../design-system.json), [contracts/policies.json](../contracts/policies.json) and the canonical [Design.md](../docs/AH_DESIGN_v2.6.md) before UI work. Use [tokens](../tokens/ah-tokens.json) and [component contracts](../contracts/components.json). Design-only output must be privacy-safe-skeleton. Home-specific Figma values apply only to Desktop/Home; do not copy product data or use old design systems. Run the validation scripts when updating files.
